segments.name: Gloo
segments.description: Provides AI-enabled technology platform, media and donor engagement solutions to churches, frontline organizations and network capability providers in the faith and flourishing ecosystem.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating segment, the Gloo segment, consistent with how its CODM, CEO , Scott Beck, reviews financial information and allocates resources.

revenueModel.text: Churches, frontline organizations and network capability providers pay subscription and services fees for technology modernization, media execution and donor engagement offerings.
revenueModel.evidence: Gloo 360 is a subscription-based offering for NCPs designed to modernize, operate and transform core IT infrastructure.
